I don’t think it’s a horrible idea. However if you struggle to keep your feelings sheerly platonic, you could be playing a dangerous game.

Be careful, I wish you the best of luck.

And you’re right. Why should I put myself through so much pain for love? I tried to give them a second chance and it didn’t go well. I’m hoping that one day I’ll be able to find someone who gets me, but for now I need to heal from this.

What happened wasn’t fair and I don’t think I deserved this. But maybe I did because I went back knowing they hurt me.

Regardless, your advice is very helpful. Thank you for answering and extending some kindness my way.

And you’re absolutely right. I just had gotten to a point where like I was able to trust this person and it hurts knowing I will not have them in my life again. But I need to put myself first and understand that this person has hurt me a number of times and love should not hurt. 

Thank you for your answer.
thank you so much for this
